# Inference Mode

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InferenceMode`](gmeow-InferenceMode.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InferenceMode>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The Peircean mode of an inference — a closed-but-open value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses; the [`gmeow:StandpointModality`](gmeow-StandpointModality.md) idiom): [`gmeow:modeDeduction`](../individuals/gmeow-modeDeduction.md), [`gmeow:modeInduction`](../individuals/gmeow-modeInduction.md), [`gmeow:modeAbduction`](../individuals/gmeow-modeAbduction.md), [`gmeow:modeAnalogical`](../individuals/gmeow-modeAnalogical.md). The mode rides as a [`gmeow:inferenceMode`](../properties/gmeow-inferenceMode.md) value on the claim (or [`gmeow:inferenceModeOf`](../properties/gmeow-inferenceModeOf.md) on the commitment), never as a subclass of [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9): no overtyping). The modes differ by warrant and default modality, not by subsumption.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InferenceMode`](gmeow-InferenceMode.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
